answer: Make every reward depend on address-bound, peer-graded work plus a vesting lock. Each epoch's challenge is unique to one address and random peers attest it, so a farmer running fifty clones must write fifty original answers and survive fifty reviews. Rewards then vest slowly, bending like a willow over weeks, so a fake can't cash out fast. A sparrow flock of copies ends up as an island: no history, no attestations from strangers, easy for graders to spot and skip.
